## 3. Project Structure Overview

### Core Packages (`kronbot/packages/`)
- **shared/**: Common types and utilities used by all Bytebot services.
- **bytebot-agent/**: Main agent service (NestJS + Prisma).
- **bytebot-agent-cc/**: Agent control center service (NestJS + Prisma).
- **bytebotd/**: Daemon/orchestrator service (NestJS).
- **bytebot-ui/**: Next.js management dashboard.
- **bytebot-llm-proxy/**: LiteLLM-based proxy for multi-provider support.

### BrowserOS Component (`kronbot/kronosOS/packages/`)
- **browseros/**: Core browser engine (Python/Playwright based).
- **browseros-agent/**: Bun-based monorepo for MCP server and extension.
  - **apps/server/**: MCP server implementation.
  - **packages/agent-sdk/**: SDK for building browser agents.
